gap: The rail EASES, it does not jump - computed transition already lists flex-basis and the rAF trace shows 19 intermediate frames 76->268px over 174ms, so that hypothesis is dead. BHD is untouched: with the whole wave stylesheet disabled vs enabled under data-product=bhd-erp, same session and same data, 0 of 5,184,000 differing pixels on dashboard/customer/invoice at 1440x900 and 0 of 1,316,640 at 390x844. Ours loses on the rail's OPEN state instead: at 268px the rail is position:fixed z-index:1000 over the page and its computed box-shadow is `none`. CDP CSS.getMatchedStylesForNode proves why - `.ant-layout-sider { box-shadow: none !important }` at frontend/src/style/partials/customAntd.css:56 outranks the non-!important `box-shadow: 18px 0 48px rgba(16,24,40,.14)` in frontend/src/style/wave/_shell.css:162. So the expanded rail guillotines the content behind a bare 1px hairline: 'Client List' renders as '...ist' and every table row is sliced mid-word ('...rated Facilities Management LLC', 'Group', 'Roasters'). The r5 pass added !important to the TRANSITION (which now animates a box-shadow that is permanently none) but never to the declaration. Evidence: shots/r4-railopen-check.png. Fix is one word - !important on _shell.css:162 - and the rest-state shell (rail, topbar, elevated content panel) already beats the bar.
